title: Strength training for arterial hypertension treatment: a systematic review and meta-analysis of randomized clinical trials.
content: PubMed PMID 36604479. Systematic review and meta-analysis of randomized trials in adults with arterial hypertension. The review found that strength-training interventions of at least eight weeks were associated with lower systolic and diastolic blood pressure; the authors describe this as a non-drug treatment option.

title: Isometric Resistance Training to Manage Hypertension: Systematic Review and Meta-analysis.
content: PubMed PMID 36853479. Systematic review and meta-analysis of trials of isometric resistance training in adults with hypertension. The review reported reductions in office systolic and diastolic blood pressure, while some ambulatory measures were not significantly reduced.

title: Exercise training for blood pressure: a systematic review and meta-analysis.
journal: Journal of the American Heart Association
content: PubMed PMID 23525435. Systematic review and meta-analysis of randomized exercise trials in adults. Endurance, dynamic resistance, and isometric resistance training lowered blood pressure in the analysed studies; effects varied by training type and participant blood-pressure status.

title: Oral antihypertensive treatment during pregnancy: a systematic review and network meta-analysis.
journal: American Journal of Obstetrics and Gynecology
content: PubMed PMID 40216176. Systematic review and network meta-analysis of oral antihypertensive treatment for hypertensive disorders of pregnancy. The review compares methyldopa, labetalol, and nifedipine and cautions that evidence quality and pregnancy-specific outcomes matter.

title: The Effect of Nursing Interventions in Women With Gestational Hypertension: A Systematic Review and Meta-Analysis.
content: PubMed PMID 40064480. Systematic review and meta-analysis of nursing interventions for gestational hypertension. Across included studies, the review reported reductions in blood pressure and some patient-centred outcomes, but it concerns pregnancy-specific care.
